clone-ipodjs-click-wheel-scroll-split-pa.name: Skeuomorphic iPod Classic with Rotary Click Wheel Scrolling, Split-Pane Menu and Cover Flow (iPod.js)
clone-ipodjs-click-wheel-scroll-split-pa.product: iPod.js — web iPod Classic by Tanner Villarete
checkpoints: Silver aluminium iPod Classic body centred on white with a floor reflection; black-bezel screen above a white click wheel (MENU / ⏮ / ⏭ / ▶❚❚) and grey centre button
Split-pane screen: left menu (Cover Flow, Music, Games, Settings, Sign in) under a grey 'iPod.js' title bar with battery; right pane previews the highlighted item
Blue gradient selection bar with › chevron; dragging around the wheel (or mouse wheel / arrow keys) moves the highlight one row per tick with a click sound
Centre button drills into a sub-menu that slides in from the right; MENU slides back
Cover Flow view: 3D album covers angled on both sides of a flat centred cover with mirror reflection, scrubbed by the wheel; title/artist under it
Now Playing screen with art, track info and progress bar; ▶❚❚ toggles playback, ⏮/⏭ change track

clone-weatherstar-4000-retro-broadcast-a.name: Retro 90s WeatherStar 4000+ Broadcast with Auto-Advancing Forecast Slides, Crawl Strip and Player Bar (WeatherStar 4000+)
clone-weatherstar-4000-retro-broadcast-a.product: WeatherStar 4000+ — retro weather channel by netbymatt
checkpoints: Location bar on top (text input + locate button + GO / Reset) above a 4:3 640×480 broadcast frame
Purple-to-orange gradient header with blue 'WEATHER STAR 4000+' logo tile, yellow two-line slide title, NOAA mark and live clock + date in white pixel type
Bevelled royal-blue content panel per slide: Current Conditions (temp, icon, wind, humidity/dewpoint/ceiling/visibility/pressure), Hourly Graph, Regional Observations map, Extended Forecast
Slides auto-advance on a timer with a hard broadcast cut; next/prev skip and pause holds the current slide
Bottom blue crawl strip cycles 'Conditions at …', Temp, Wind and Visibility lines and a scrolling ticker
Black player bar: menu, prev, next, play/pause, refresh, mute, fullscreen; selected-displays checkboxes and speed setting below

clone-16personalities-illustrated-step-c.name: Illustrated 3-Step Cards with 7-Circle Agree/Disagree Scale and Auto-Focus Question Progression (16Personalities)
checkpoints: White top nav with dotted 16Personalities logo, 'Personality Test' active tab with teal top underline, dropdown menus, accessibility/language icons and Log in
Light grey hero with dotted logo mark, big slate 'Free Personality Test' title and 'NERIS Type Explorer®' subtitle over a soft white wave
Three illustrated step cards with coloured top border (blue / green / purple): STEP pill, title and description
Question rows: statement + 7 circles sized large→small→large between green 'Agree' and purple 'Disagree' labels
Only the active question is coloured; answering fills the circle, dims the row and smooth-scrolls/focuses the next question
Progress bar updates as questions are answered; Next button pages to the next set
